isolation.boundary: guest/public/auth routes only; no shared authenticated state mutation; single browser context

assertions.title: Redirect targets are sanitized to validated internal paths

steps.expected: Safe guest redirect intent remains on the sign-in URL
Unsafe external redirect target is stripped and sign-in falls back to the default destination intent
steps.observed: URL normalized to http://localhost:3000/auth/signin with no external redirectedFrom value

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during both sign-in route loads
evidence.network: Document navigations to /auth/signin completed with client-visible URL normalization; no separate API call required

assertions.title: Guest sign-in surfaces inline validation, submission status, and cooldown feedback

steps.expected: Inline validation message should appear before or after submit
steps.observed: Only the email textbox and submit button remained visible; no inline validation text was surfaced in the visible guest UI

steps.action: Submit invalid email through Send magic link
steps.expected: The form should show validation/submission feedback and prevent ambiguous duplicate submission
steps.observed: The page remained visually unchanged after submit, with no visible loading, success, or cooldown feedback captured in the UI screenshots

evidence.network: No explicit network evidence captured because the guest surface provided no visible request/result feedback for the invalid submission

assertions.issues: Live sign-in surface did not visibly present inline validation, submission status, or cooldown feedback for the tested invalid-email flow.

assertions.title: Magic-link callback failures are translated into guest-safe messages

steps.action: Open /auth/signin with error=access_denied and an expired-link error_description
steps.expected: Guest should see understandable expired/invalid-link messaging on sign-in
steps.observed: URL preserved the raw auth error query, but the rendered page showed only the standard sign-in content with no visible guest-safe error message

evidence.network: Direct document navigation to /auth/signin?error=access_denied&error_description=... with no visible translated error state

assertions.issues: Callback failure query did not render guest-safe expired/invalid-link messaging on the sign-in surface.

assertions.title: Authenticated guests entering home are sent to the guest dashboard

steps.action: Open / on the live guest surface
steps.expected: An authenticated guest session would redirect to /guest/dashboard
steps.observed: Without an isolated authenticated guest fixture, the browser remained on the public landing page at http://localhost:3000/

evidence.network: Document request loaded / with no redirect in an unauthenticated browser context

assertions.issues: No dedicated authenticated guest browser fixture was available within the assigned isolation boundary, so the authenticated-home redirect could not be proven safely.

assertions.title: Sign-in returns guests to the intended destination

steps.action: Review live guest sign-in redirect sanitization behavior
steps.expected: After successful auth completion, a safe redirectedFrom target should return the guest to the intended destination
steps.observed: Pre-auth URL sanitization could be observed, but no isolated post-auth completion fixture or safe authenticated callback harness was available to complete the flow without mutating shared auth state

evidence.network: Only pre-auth document navigations were exercised; post-auth redirect completion was not available in the isolated browser context

assertions.issues: Blocked from safely proving post-auth return behavior because no dedicated auth-completion fixture was available and the assignment prohibited mutating shared authenticated state.

assertions.title: Authenticated visits to /auth canonicalize to the correct signed-in destination

steps.action: Open /auth in the assigned live browser context
steps.expected: An authenticated guest should redirect to /guest/dashboard and an authenticated owner/admin should redirect to /app
steps.observed: In the unauthenticated browser context, /auth rendered the guest role-selection page and no authenticated redirect could be exercised

evidence.network: Document request loaded /auth with no redirect in the available unauthenticated context

assertions.issues: No authenticated guest or owner/admin browser fixture was available within the assigned isolation boundary, so the signed-in canonicalization behavior could not be validated safely.

frictions.resolution: Read the repo-root guidance file and followed its browser validation section.

frictions.description: No isolated authenticated browser fixture or auth-completion harness was available for guest/owner sign-in redirect assertions within the allowed boundary.
frictions.resolution: Recorded affected assertions as blocked instead of mutating shared authenticated state.

blockers.description: Authenticated redirect assertions could not be completed because the assignment prohibited shared authenticated-state mutation and no dedicated isolated signed-in fixture was available.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Validated the available unauthenticated routes and looked for a dedicated public/auth fixture in the allowed surface, but none was exposed.

summary: Tested 6 assigned assertions via one browser session: 1 passed (VAL-FOUNDATION-005), 2 failed (VAL-DISCOVERY-009, VAL-DISCOVERY-011), and 3 were blocked by the lack of an isolated authenticated fixture (VAL-DISCOVERY-002, VAL-CROSS-002, VAL-CROSS-007).
